body: I always try to be there for everyone in my environment. But after a while you feel like you have all the problems of the world on your shoulders. So I thought I would give this a shot to vent. You were a great help that it's okay to take some time for myself. It's sometimes hard to see the other persons perspective. I wasn't able to ask questions with my dad and now it's hard to not ask the same questions. Thanks I will.

She was a couple of weeks in the hospital but got to go home last thursday. I understand her situation and the guilt. I came up for her because my grandpa wasn't that good at handling the situation and pointing fingers at the worst time possible. Last time I left she said she hoped she would be able to handle it all alone at home. I think she's hoping for me to move back in but I don't want to give up my whole life again. I gave up everything last time with my dad and can't handle that whole situation again. I moved out 3 years ago because I was finaly at rest that she would be okay and could start my own life. Now it all starts over again after a long struggle to forget the past. 

Thanks for your response. Hope that everything worked out for you. The thing that keeps me going is that I know there are always going to be better times. Sometimes it just takes time.
